message.content: In one of the conversations, Jennifer Moore mentioned that she wanted Li Hua to fill out a quick survey about their experience with the training sessions. This was communicated to Li Hua on June 22nd at 11:00 AM, where Jennifer encouraged him to complete the survey as her feedback would help her improve the training sessions. Specifically, Jennifer wrote, "Could you please fill out a quick survey about your experience with our training sessions so far? Your feedback really helps me improve! 😊"
